text:
elaine_cs: Quick heads up — AcmeCorp renewal (50 seats) cleared internally. Procurement needs: PO number, vendor code, and DocuSign executed by their Finance lead. They also asked for a security addendum signed by their Security team. They asked whether credit card payment is acceptable vs wire. Request: close by Friday EOD. Who will drive signatures and payment path? cc @mike_acct @jordan_legal

mike_acct: I can own vendor code & PO. Reaching out to Melissa in Procurement now to confirm PO fields and GL code. ETA ~24h.

jordan_legal: From Legal, we prefer our standard T&Cs. For the security addendum, need to confirm if their team accepts our SOC2 attestation or expects a bespoke addendum. @tom_success can you ask the buyer for the addendum draft?

tom_success: Spoke with the buyer — their portal enforces a 3-approver flow (procurement, legal, finance). They *can* do credit card but it incurs ~2% processing fee on their side. They prefer vendor code + PO to avoid fees.

sophia_fin: If CC is used, we still require a PO with a "credit card final" note for our records. If they choose net30/PO route and it's billed to an EU entity, we'll need finance approval for invoice splitting and VAT handling. CC is faster for activation. :thinking_face: 

elaine_cs: Decision checkpoint: CC or PO? If CC -> DocuSign only by their finance lead. If PO/net30 -> need invoice split info & billing entity confirmed. @jordan_legal any redlines on pricing or term change?

jordan_legal: Pricing OK. They asked to shorten term from 12 -> 9 months (pro rata). That affects seat true-up timing and renewal window. Recommend we accept 9-month pro rata but keep auto-renew as-is. Any objections?

mike_acct: 9 months works for billing. I'll update SOW dates and insert pro rata clause. Preparing amended SOW and procurement instructions now.

tom_success: Scheduling a 30-min signoff call tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize. Can @elaine_cs @mike_acct @jordan_legal @sophia_fin join?

sophia_fin: 10am PT works — I'll bring our billing lead for vendor-code confirmation.

esign-bot: Draft envelope created: AcmeRenewal_2790012345. Waiting for final SOW attachment. Doc link: https://docusign.example/renewal/xyz789

mike_acct: Procurement sample email I'll send to Melissa (cc'ing attendees):

```
Subject: PO request - Redwood Inference for AcmeCorp
Hi Melissa,

AcmeCorp needs a PO to process the renewal. Please provide a PO number using vendor code VC-9987 and GL code 4510. Attached: amended SOW (dates adjusted to 9-month term) and billing instructions. Note: if customer selects EU billing entity, use VC-RE-EU-01.

Thanks,
Mike
```

elaine_cs: Attaching SOW v2: https://files.example/acme/sow-v2.pdf — updated dates + pro rata clause. Please review before the 10am call.

jordan_legal: Quick legal pass done. One minor edit: replace "liquidated damages" language in section 6 with "service credits". I'll push that redline to the SOW and upload prior to the call.

mike_acct: Procurement confirmed vendor code VC-9987 for US entity. Portal note: if they select EU billing entity, use VC-RE-EU-01. @sophia_fin please confirm billing routing.

sophia_fin: Confirmed mapping. VC-9987 = Redwood Inc (US). VC-RE-EU-01 = Redwood EU (VAT ID on file). Customer must select correct billing entity in the portal or invoice will route incorrectly and delay payment.

elaine_cs: Plan recap: 1) Calendar invite sent for 10am PT signoff. 2) If CC route, we'll send DocuSign and they can pay same day. 3) If PO route, expect 48-72h procurement processing after PO submission. Target: signature complete by Friday. :party_parrot: 

tom_success: Invite sent (calendar + join link). If blockers appear before the call, drop them here and I will escalate.

(edited) tom_success: Buyer also requested a brief onboarding checklist to start immediately after signature. I'll draft a 1-page enablement plan and post it here after the call.
